race.comment: Hard work this, and it looks like the perfect launching pad for PERFECT RIPOSTE (5), a first-starter from the powerful Lindsay Park team. Son of Savabeel, so debuting at this trip won't be a problem, and he comes here off two nice Flemington jumpout efforts, including a win at the latest. He's drawn well, and so has TERRACOTTA WARRIOR (8), who should get every favour from the draw. Debut was adequate, but it is worth noting it came in a race of much more depth than this, so only getting beaten 3 lengths was a positive. STASH ROYALE (10) is another first-starter drawn favourably who has looked at the most recent trials ahead of the debut. MYSTIC RAPTURE (4) has had a heap of chances but has performed well in better races than this, so might sneak a placing. LADY BLANC (9) trialled encouragingly coming into the debut campaign and will be better for the first start.
